title: Loan intake service: what ends up in the application logs
name: Loan application logging

questions.prompt: A security review of our log aggregator found applicants' social security numbers and birth dates in plain text in the lending intake logs. The service code explicitly logs only a masked SSN on the approval line, and nobody added a log statement for the other fields, yet they are there on the received and rejected lines. Fix LoanApplication.java so the tests pass.
